author: vanaukenk
body:
Hi,

GAF QC at WB flagged three annotations from ComplexPortal for which we didn't have the reference in WB, but it looks like it is actually an incorrect PMID.

CPXP | Q19642 | czw-1 | located_in | GO:0000776 | kinetochore | ECO:0000314(IDA) | PMID:2431804

CPXP | Q20849 | rod-1 | located_in | GO:0000776 | kinetochore | ECO:0000314(IDA) | PMID:2431804

CPXP | Q95XP9 | zwl-1 | located_in | GO:0000776 | kinetochore | ECO:0000314(IDA) | PMID:2431804

PMID:2431804 in each of these annotations should be PMID:24231804.

@sandraorchard @alexsign 

Thanks.
title: Incorrect PMID for three C. elegans annotations from ComplexPortal

author: sandraorchard
body: Corrected - one digit missing. Thanks for letting us know,

author: vanaukenk
body:
@sandraorchard @alexsign - Do you know when this correction will percolate through to Protein2GO?  

Thank you!

author: sandraorchard
body: Complex Portal release running now, so should be available in next P2GO release.
